findings.description: The guard itself is correct — filling/clicking the target-week input and Save button never opens the file picker. However, the dropzone target-week Save does not visually persist: the value IS written to the backend (lb_deliverables.csv gets target_week), but the immediate drawer re-render shows an empty input. Root cause: makeTargetWeekEditor's onAfterSave calls openDrawer() directly instead of refreshSilently().then(openDrawer). openDrawer rebuilds from the stale in-memory TRK.lb_deliverables, which does not yet contain the just-written row/target_week (API.action POST does not refresh TRK), so the editor re-renders blank until a manual/auto reload. This is a state-preservation defect (overlaps Agent 3's domain), not an event-propagation leak. No data loss — the value persists to CSV.
findings.repro: Log in as admin. NPI tab > click the bold project-id of the first NOT STARTED project. In the first .dz, type a week into .target-week-editor input[type=week] and click Save. Observe the input reverts to empty; the value is nonetheless present in system/tracking/lb_deliverables.csv (target_week).
